summary:
TWO-WEEK WINDOW (8/28 09:03 -> 9/11 09:03), reported as one period because the 9/4 run crashed before delivery. Thirteen messages in fourteen days: 10 from ALTR, 2 from Hailey, 1 service event. The composition is the finding. ALTR's ten messages break down as four billing (Stephski's 9/1 invoice, its PDF, a 9/5 nudge, a 9/6 'Appreciate you!'), three demands (Mayson's 8/30 content Drive with a 7-reels-a-week / 30-a-month quota, Mayson's 9/4 call request, Michelle's 9/10 content chase), two scheduled broadcasts (Michelle's leak-removal recaps 9/1 and 9/8) and one recurring posting nudge (Mica, 8/31). Zero answered anything she has outstanding. Not one of the ten was a human closing an open item. Derrek did not post. Vivek did not post.

Her two messages were both in the Invoicing topic and both about paying: 'Yesss ill send over!' (9/5, nine minutes after Stephski's nudge) and 'Just sent over to the wire that’s on the newest invoice' (9/7). That broke a 16-day silence - but it was broken by a collections nudge, not by outreach, and the asymmetry is stark: she answers a bill in nine minutes and has left four consecutive ALTR asks unanswered (the 8/27 .vip domain question, 15 days; the 8/30 Drive + quota, 12 days; the 9/4 call request, 7 days; the 9/10 content chase, 1 day). She is not gone. She is transacting and nothing else.

Payment closed cleanly on the surface - invoice 9/1, 7-day terms, paid 9/7, one day inside terms, cycle 26 of 26. Underneath it got worse: on 8/20 she wired to last month's account on Derrek's verbal say-so ('thats fine'), on 9/7 she wired to 'the wire that’s on the newest invoice'. Two consecutive cycles to what may be two different destinations, and ALTR has confirmed receipt of NEITHER in writing - the 8/20 wire is 22 days unreconciled, the 9/7 wire 4 days.

The content quota is already failing: Mayson issued a 7-reels-a-week quota on 8/30 and 11 days later Michelle wrote 'I noticed there hasn’t been anything uploaded yet' - on a different thread, which is the sprawl problem restating itself. Everything else aged: .vip domains 90 days, shadowban 44 days, Derrek's own phone-farm update 41 days, named account manager 173 days. A ChatAddUser event fired at 21:01 on 9/10 - someone was added to the group and has not spoken.

health.rationale: Sixth consecutive decline (80 -> 68 -> 65 -> 58 -> 54 -> 51), but the shallowest yet, and the composition of the score has changed. The acute churn signal eased: she returned after 16 days, answered in nine minutes, and paid inside terms for the 26th cycle in a row. That is real floor support and it is why this is a 3-point slip, not a collapse. What kept it falling is that fourteen days and ten ALTR messages produced zero answers to anything she has asked for, and two items actively worsened. First, there are now TWO consecutive wires - 8/20 and 9/7 - sent to what appear to be two different accounts, with no written confirmation of receipt for either; Stephski proved on 5/20 she can do this in one sentence ('Hi Haleigh we recieved your wire'). Second, the 8/30 content quota has zero compliance at 11 days and is now being chased by a second person on a third thread, which is the exact friction she complained about in February. Her behaviour is the clearest read available: nine-minute response to a bill, four unanswered asks. That is a client who has stopped expecting service from this chat but still expects the invoice to be right.

At least the fifth intake channel she has been handed (Content Snare, the 2/15 Drive, a shared iPhone album with Michelle 6/17, a second with Ronnie 7/6, now this), against a 212-day-old standing request for ONE place to upload. client_priorities: IG main-account safety above everything: shadowbans, flagged links (juicy.bio, link.me, the ALTR-built .vip domains), impersonation bans on backups. Responsiveness and one named point of contact with a real SLA - complained explicitly on 3/22 and 4/22, lived it on the 8/18-8/20 payment question, and this window answered nothing across ten ALTR messages. Payment clarity - she pays fast and reliably (26 of 26 cycles) when she knows where to send. Every piece of recent friction is ALTR-side banking churn, not her.

Brand voice: she must approve customs before acceptance (Nick Scott agreed 2025-12-29), and no text emoticons from chatters.

Frictionless content submission - ONE place, one process. She called Content Snare 'my biggest issue' in February; she is now on her fifth intake channel, carries a 30-reels-a-month quota, and is being chased for the same content by two different people on two different threads.

wins: She came back and she paid. Sixteen days of silence broke on 9/5 with a nine-minute reply, and the Aug 15-31 invoice was paid on 9/7, one day inside terms - cycle 26 of 26. The churn alarm from the 9/4 read has eased; this is not a client heading for the exit this week.
Michelle's weekly leak-removal recap landed on schedule twice in the window (9/1 and 9/8). It remains the only deliverable on this account with a completely unbroken record across a full year.
Stephski's collections loop worked exactly as designed: invoice 9/1, single nudge 9/5, payment 9/7. One nudge, no friction, no chasing.

Mayson's 9/4 call offer on trial reels is the first forward-looking, value-shaped proposal anyone has put to her since Derrek's 8/1 message. The impulse is right even though it went unanswered and even though it came from the person owing her the oldest open item.
